newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to 25.542 bln stg in week to Aug 13.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to 25.542 bln stg in week to Aug 13.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.542 billion stg in the week to August 13 from 25.463 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 25.830 billion stg from 25.785 billion.

Notes and coins in circulation were slightly higher at 25.425 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis from 25.394 billion the week before but fell to 25.713 billion from 25.716 billion stg on an unadjusted basis. -- London Newsroom 44 171 542 7715
